title: 港铁先建站再等人：屯马线当年一片空地，如今最忙线路还能复制吗？
speaker: Jenny Yeung

segments.en: Now it's sort of like you build the infrastructure first and then everything else will come with it.
segments.zh: 现在的做法是先建基础设施，然后其他一切都会随之而来。

segments.en: Does it change how you look at risk management and the like right now moving forward?
segments.zh: 这是否改变了您对风险管理等方面的看法？

segments.en: I would, you know, look at it in a field perspective. In fact, this is not the first time in Hong Kong that the infrastructure go first.
segments.zh: 我会从更宏观的角度来看。事实上，香港并非首次采用基建先行的模式。

segments.en: Even like, if you remember, a colonization, when we first built the colonization, the Apple Express line, the Hong Kong line, colonization, there was nothing, right?
segments.zh: 比如，如果你还记得，当初建设将军澳线时，那里什么都没有，对吧？

segments.en: And then property development gradually come in and then the cultural district. And also the high speed station as well as some other example like that in Westwell line.
segments.zh: 然后地产开发逐渐进入，接着是文化区。还有高铁站以及西铁线等其他例子。

segments.en: Now it's called the Timon line. I still remember, you know, 20 years ago when it was up, development was not yet there.
segments.zh: 现在叫屯马线。我还记得20年前它刚开通时，开发还没跟上。

segments.en: So quite a few patch in it. But now it built up to be one of the busiest line in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 所以当时有不少空地。但现在它已成为香港最繁忙的线路之一。

segments.en: So different approaches, different mirrored. But we definitely have the experience and we believe transportation will bring people.
segments.zh: 所以方法不同，模式也不同。但我们确实有经验，我们相信交通会带来人流。

segments.en: So it's just that in the whole business case, when we look into that, we will time. You know, when the population will come in, when the development will be happening.
segments.zh: 所以在整个商业案例中，我们会把握时机，知道人口何时流入，开发何时发生。

segments.en: So we believe this is still one of the good approach in building up the community, in building up the, like in North America, which is going to be very important for Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 所以我们相信这仍是建设社区的好方法，就像在北美一样，这对香港非常重要。
